Normal registration, Stripe Sandbox payment, owner assignment, photographer GPS check-in, and logout/login. Temporary address provided by user: va39he2rm4@gmeenramy.com on temp-mail.io. No credentials for user's personal mailbox were requested or used.

defect_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Payment success view unconditionally stated a confirmation email had been sent, but no payment receipt mail existed anywhere in the code path.
defect_found_and_fixed.proof_before_fix: Stripe Sandbox charged ₱2,370.00; success page claimed a confirmation email; temp inbox received no payment message after repeated refreshes.
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: Added PaymentReceiptMail with receipt, amount, total, and balance. paymentSuccess now attempts delivery, logs failures, and passes receiptEmailSent so the page claims delivery only when the attempt succeeded. If delivery fails, it tells the user to keep or print the page as receipt.
regressions: New test for receipt contents initially failed because remaining_balance column was missing in the isolated schema; fixed test fixture only.
New test confirmed route sends exactly one PaymentReceiptMail to the booking client, after adding missing UserModel schema columns in the isolated fixture.
View test failed first with the old unconditional claim, then passed after the conditional copy.
Focused booking/auth suite: 13 tests passed, 65 assertions.
defect_found_and_fixed.browser_retest: Success page now states 'A payment receipt email was sent...' only after a real send. Temp inbox then received Payment received - BK-6AEA0DF825ABF with matching values.
defect_found_and_fixed.duplicate_send_fix: Reloading the success page previously resent the receipt. New test reproduced 2 sends across 2 requests, then passed after adding a receipt_emailed_at marker to the payment record. Browser proof: original 1 receipt, then first guarded visit added 1 (legacy payment had no marker), a second reload added 0, leaving exactly 2 'Payment received - BK-6AEA0DF825ABF' messages in the temp inbox.

additional_observations.actual: Temporary client completed Skip on first-login tutorial and reached dashboard. The tutorial Skip button completed onboarding normally; earlier keyboard trap finding was on the booking form, not this tutorial.

Booking BK-6AEA0DF825ABF created on December 1, 2026 10:00-13:00 for basic fixed 3-hour package, ₱7,900 total, ₱2,370 deposit. Owner assigned Bernadette; photographer accepted; GPS check-in at 299 m succeeded; booking moved to IN PROGRESS upon arrival, as designed.
additional_observations.note: Stripe Sandbox only; test data explicitly identified.

limitations: Temp-mail.io is a third-party disposable inbox. Delivery proves SMTP acceptance and receipt into that inbox, not deliverability to a specific real mailbox provider.
Single-use verification link confirmed; expiry behavior at 24 hours was not waited on.
Full receipt print-dialog output was not exercised under the one-tab rule; booking and email value matching were verified.
No claim that all other email paths (studio approval, employee onboarding, subscription lifecycle) were delivered.
